sloka: विंध्य मेरु गिरि प्रख्यैः प्रासादैः न एक भूमिभिः ।ददर्श गिरि नद्यः च विमलाः तत्र राघवः ॥४-३३-८॥
transliteration: viṁdhya meru giri prakhyaiḥ prāsādaiḥ na eka bhūmibhiḥ ।dadarśa giri nadyaḥ ca vimalāḥ tatra rāghavaḥ ॥4-33-8॥

translations.english: Lakshmana saw tall buildings comparable to Vindhya and Meru mountains and pure water flowing from the mountain streams.
